mapper.select: select mn.* , mr.mr_serial_number as mrSerialNumber,mr.Mr_Report_Amount_Pre as mrReportAmountPre , sc.C_NAME as constructionUnitName , sc2.C_NAME as auditUnitName , sc3.C_NAME as constructionContractorName , mr.P_NAME as pName, mr.Mr_Create_Uid as mrCreateUid, mr.Mr_Create_Uname as mrCreateUname from construction_completion_confirm mn left join maintenance_record mr on mr.mr_id = mn.mr_id left join sys_company sc on sc.C_ID = mn.Construction_Unit left join sys_company sc2 on sc2.C_ID = mn.Audit_Unit left join sys_company sc3 on sc3.C_ID = mn.Construction_Contractor where mn.id = #{id}
